project_description.value: Design-build demolition of three smoke exhaust fans (F-14, F-15, F-16), each 20,000 CFM axial fans, from mechanical rooms in Building 285 at NAS Oceana. Scope includes removal of fans, associated ductwork, duct silencers, electrical circuits, and exterior louvers; infill of three 72"x30" louver openings with 8" CMU and EIFS to match existing; structural infill of three ~46" floor openings left by demolished ductwork; and replacement of acoustical ceiling tiles disturbed by demolition.
project_description.quote: Demolish Three Smoke Exhaust Fans F-14, F-15, F-16 each (20,000 CFM) from Mechanical Rooms in Building 285. Work shall also include demolition of Ductwork, and Louvers (72"x30") and the associated Electrical Components and disposal off government property of demolished items. Openings left from demolition of louvers shall be infilled with masonry and finished to match/coordinate with existing construction.

delivery_type.notes: Contract structured as design-build RFP per multiple references: 'Designer of Record (DOR)', 'design-build contract', UFGS design-build specifications throughout.

scope_summary.mechanical: Demolish exhaust fans F-14, F-15, F-16 (30" dia., ~540 lbs each, 20,000 CFM axial); remove ductwork (180 SF + 105 SF to louver per fan), duct silencers (30" dia., 60 lbs each), hangers, and appurtenances from second-floor mechanical room to first-floor ceiling.
scope_summary.electrical: Demolish all electrical circuits feeding fans F-14, F-15, F-16 — conductors, raceway, junction boxes, disconnect switches, transformer — back to source panel.
scope_summary.architectural: Remove three 72"x30" exterior louvers and flashing; infill openings with 8" CMU + 1" EPS board + vinyl copolymer aggregate finish on reinforcing fabric to match existing EIFS. Remove mechanical ceiling grills; replace disturbed ACT.
scope_summary.structural: Infill three ~46" diameter openings in mechanical room concrete floor (left by 42" dia. duct demolition); infill designed for 50 PSF LL or 1000 lb point load, flush with existing floor; 3-1/4" reinforced concrete slab on 11-ga light gauge metal plate on HSS2x4 tubes connected to existing ring plates.
